body:
Sub-tasks (approved plan):
1. Bridge refuses connection takeover (setConnection returns result; accepts when no prev, prev closed, same installId, prev idle >45s, or same socket re-hello)
2. Hello handler: stamp activity on every message, check takeover first, close refused socket with 4409 connection_in_use
3. Takeover tests
4. Extension: clear status + slower retry on 4409
5. Workflow site-policy blocks return the standard blocked envelope (or ok:true + policyBlocked when the workflow caught the block); policy blocks excluded from formatter health
6. #114 test coverage (type/scroll/getAccessibilityTree, mid-run disconnect, missing tab_id, swallowed block, cause chain, health)
Note: real envelope fields are tabWillCloseAt / tabCloseInSeconds (issue text had willCloseAt/closeInSeconds).
